_comment: Agent files test_outputs.py checks for this task, matching what its instruction.md asks for.
required: missing or empty fails the test. expected: only warned about.
Every variant requires the same two files, the ones without which there is nothing to
score, so a maximal and a minimal trial fail the test under the same conditions. This is
the maximal list: its prompt also asks for notes, a README, a sample pickle and six logs,
which are recorded and warned about but do not fail the test; the LLM judges are what
assess the notes and README. <task>_minimal and <task>_datalimit expect nothing further.
The judge instructions describe the same files.
